{"has_issues": true, "issues": ["The memo frames as a mitigating factor that future unsecured debt restrictions \u201ccannot be materially more restrictive\u201d than the current agreement, but this actually prevents only more-restrictive terms and expressly allows equal or less-restrictive terms\u2014i.e., it does not mitigate (and in fact enables) the stated risk that the amendment permits less restrictive future debt arrangements."]}
